reason: A visual theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds Dracula and Dracula Soft palettes with selection through Settings → General.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Dracula 和 Dracula Soft 两种配色主题，并支持在设置中切换。
summaries.en: Adds Dracula and Dracula Soft color themes to DeepSeek Harness with switching through the settings interface.

capabilities: Adds Dracula and Dracula Soft visual themes
Registers themes in the DSH theme runtime
Persists the selected theme across sessions
